Founded in 2023, the company develops large language models (LLMs) such as Indus and multimodal AI systems with a focus on Indian languages and region-specific use cases. The company has received venture capital backing and has participated in government-supported AI initiatives, including India's sovereign large language model programme under the IndiaAI Mission.
